dedupe_keys.name: simulated and measured greenhouse microclimate series for a calibration free crop coupled energyplus co simulation 278 day paprika cycle

description: Simulated and measured greenhouse microclimate series for a calibration-free, crop-coupled EnergyPlus co-simulation (278-day paprika cycle) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Young Kwang Jeon, Dong Cheol Jang (Kangwon National University). This dataset contains the simulated and measured time series required to reproduce the validation results of a calibration-free, crop-coupled EnergyPlus co-simulation of the year-round microclimate in a naturally ventilated commercial paprika greenhouse (Inje, Gangwon, Republic of Korea). The record spans the full 278-day cultivation cycle from 14 February to 18 November 2023. Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
